name: Short hop
goal: Short hop ten times in a row.
why: A short hop is lower and shorter than a full hop. Aerials from a short hop reach grounded opponents, and you land sooner, before they can punish.

tutorial.what: A short hop is a jump with the jump button released during jump squat. It is lower and shorter than a full hop.
tutorial.expect: Each jump is judged when {char} leaves the ground: short hop or full hop, and how many frames the jump button was held. After misses, the coach shows your inputs frame by frame against the {J}-frame jump squat.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat. X was released, so this is a short hop

lessons.title: The jump squat
text: Pressing jump does not lift {char} off the ground at once. {char} first crouches for {J} frames: the jump squat. Release jump on any frame of the jump squat and you short hop; hold it through all {J} frames and you full hop.
Jump squat length differs by character, from 3 frames to Bowser's 8. A longer jump squat gives you more time to release: {char} has {J-1} frames. When you switch characters, the timing changes.

lessons.title: How to short hop
lessons.text: The game checks the jump button on every frame of jump squat. Released on any of them, you short hop; held through all {J}, you full hop. For {char}, hold jump for {J-1} frames at most. Green frames are in time; the red frame is too late.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.2: Frame {f}: jump squat. Released now, you still short hop
marks.J-1: Frame {J-1}: the last frame jump can be held for a short hop
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat. Held here, you full hop
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: airborne. Released in time: short hop

with a button.headline: Jumped with the stick
with a button.fix: Jump with X or Y and release it during jump squat. With the stick, you short hop only if the stick comes back down during jump squat.

released in the squat.expect: X or Y released within {J-1} frames
released in the squat.headline: Held through jump squat
released in the squat.fix: Release X or Y within {J-1} frames of pressing it. Held through all {J} frames of jump squat, you full hop.

short hop.headline: Full hop
short hop.fix: Tap X or Y: release it within {J-1} frames.

parts.name: The jump squat
parts.teach: Press X once. {char} crouches for {J} frames before leaving the ground: the jump squat.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat

parts.success: Jump: {J} frames of jump squat, then airborne.

parts.name: Tap, do not hold
parts.teach: Press X and release it within {J-1} frames, before jump squat ends. Released in time, {char} short hops. Held through all {J} frames, {char} full hops.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.2: Frame 2: X released. Still in jump squat

parts.name: Ten in a row
parts.teach: Ten short hops in a row, at your own pace. Each hop should reach the same height.

mistakes.name: held to the top of the jump

coach.note: Jump squat is {J} frames: release X or Y within {J-1} frames.
